acceptance_criteria.description: CoopSave validation rejects every set trainer, gym, Fly-point, or event ordinal that is absent from the generated identity registry, while accepting assigned boundary ordinals.
Corrupt, incompatible, erased, and otherwise offline-only load classifications deterministically clear runtime regional progress and preserve incompatible bytes where required.
Generation increment including u32 wrap is deterministic and covered by focused tests.
Every successful canonical persistent save path after cloud negotiation is checkpoint-authorized and emits exactly one generation-correlated SAVE_DATA_UPDATED; failure and cancellation emit none.
Focused Cloud Coop and SaveBlock3 ARM tests, identity generator check, modern ROM build, and diff checks pass.

closed_decisions: CoopSaveV1 remains a frozen 672-byte CSP1 schema at SaveBlock3 offset 4 with registry version 1 and digest 43918833dec646d6a583d124686c8540.
Trainer, gym, Fly-point, and event bitsets are append-only ordinal sets; a set unassigned ordinal is incompatible and must fail closed.
Zeroed or erased legacy extensions remain sealed with MIGRATION_AMBIGUOUS and offline-only; arbitrary partially populated bytes are not silently migrated.
A failed, corrupt, or incompatible load must expose no prior regional progress from another attempted slot.

Every successful persistent save that advances save_generation after cloud negotiation must produce one correlated SAVE_DATA_UPDATED notification carrying the little-endian u32 generation; no failed save emits it.
Offline PokéCrossroads saves remain available before cloud negotiation, and checkpoint authorization must not recurse or duplicate writes.

rtk wsl -d Ubuntu-24.04 --cd C:/Users/User/Documents/personal/hoenn-sessions -- make check TESTS=SaveBlock3

forbidden_changes: Do not edit Rust crates, generated registry artifacts, launcher, server, sidecar, Lua, documentation outside this worker contract, or orchestration state.
Do not change the frozen SaveBlock3/CoopSaveV1 layout, registry version/digest, bridge ABI, protocol version, or message numbers.
Do not invent identity assignments, accept unassigned bits, silently migrate ambiguous bytes online, or permit stale progress after a failed load.
Do not stage, commit, branch, fetch, pull, push, contact remotes, or distribute ROM output.
Do not revert or overwrite edits made by other active workers; adapt to the shared worktree.
objective: Harden PokéCrossroads regional save persistence so only assigned identities survive validation, failed loads cannot leak stale progress, and every canonical save generation is correlated with the bridge checkpoint protocol.

return_when: Every acceptance criterion is resolved and each required verification command has a recorded outcome.
A safe notification contract cannot be implemented without changing an unowned engine caller or the frozen wire ABI.
A concrete build, toolchain, or shared-worktree conflict prevents further progress within the owned files and budget.
